fullContent:
Nimbaharidradi Churnam 
 Reference – Astangahradayam Kustachikitsa 19. 
 Introduction 
 Nimbaharidradi Churnam is an ayurvedic formulation which is formed from various herbs mixture. This is especially effective in treating the problems of skin. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Nimba-patra (Azadiracta indica)        
 Haridra (Curcuma longa) 
 Chanda (Chrysopogon aciculatus) 
 Kusta (Sauserra lappa)            
 Daruharidra (Berberis aristata) 
 Tejabala (Zanthoxylum limonella) 
 Tulsi (Ocimum sanctum) 
 Vanya (Cyperus rotundus) 
 Shweth (Brassica campestris) 
 Devadaru (Cedrus deodara)   
 Patola  (Trichosanthes dioica) 
 Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera)  
 Shigru  (Moringa oleifera) 
 
 Method of preparation 
 
 Took all the herbs in the quantity of one part. 
 Powdered all the ingredients separately. 
 Now mixed all the powder and your Churna is ready. 
 
 Dose 
 As this Churna is for external use, take the powder and mixed with buttermilk. Apply this mixture on affected area. 
 Indications 
 
 Scabies 
 Erysipelas 
 Eczema 
 Insect bites 
 Sinus 
 Dermatitis 
 Diabetes carbuncle 
 Non-healing wounds 
 
 Contraindications 
 No side effects. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
